title: gossypium barbadense subsp. racemosum
intro: Gossypium barbadense subsp. racemosum, commonly known as Pima cotton, is a subspecies of the cotton plant native to the Americas. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions such as skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Gossypium barbadense subsp. racemosum include wound healing, anti-aging, and anti-infective actions, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides. The bioactive constituents of this plant may also exhibit antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic activities, contributing to its potential health benefits.
